who: Bruce Gordon, historian of the Reformation and early modern European religious cultures, Yale faculty since 2008.

evidence.says: Yale identifies Bruce Gordon as professor of Reformation history, with research in late medieval and early modern European religious cultures; he joined Yale in 2008.
The candidate authority is Fon Louise Gordon, author of Caste and Class (1995).
UCF identifies Fon L. Gordon as a history professor specializing in African-American history and American car culture, with a University of Arkansas PhD (1989), and lists Caste and Class.

notes: Reject p-43900: Fon Louise Gordon and Yale's Bruce Gordon are different scholars.

who: George H. Callcott, historian of the United States and the South, University of Maryland; PhD North Carolina, 1956.

who: Hasan Kwame Jeffries, historian of civil rights and Black Power at Ohio State; PhD American history, Duke, 2002.
